title: The weighing at the vault-door credits 'Meva's ledger' as one of the three sources for the moneyers' names, but reading Meva's ledger of faces ('read the ledger of faces outright') only ever returns flavor text about finding 'the gap-year,' never a name the way Doran's touchstone-record ('Corbet, Wyle, and Hann') or Robin's river-penny ('Hann') plainly do. The third name-source is credited without ever being shown to the reader.
where: The Tithe-House / 'read the ledger of faces outright'; The Vault-Door / 'weigh what this grief asks'
